scene: sitting on a wet bench in a tram shelter at night, looking down at a paper ticket

title.en: At the tram stop in the rain

intro.ko: 크림 목도리와 오트밀 케이블 니트가 에스프레소 코트 안쪽을 밝힌다.
intro.en: A cream scarf and an oatmeal cable knit brighten the inside of the espresso coat.
intro.de: Ein cremefarbener Schal und haferfarbener Zopfstrick hellen den espressobraunen Mantel auf.

deck.ko: 비 오는 저녁 정류장 벤치에 앉아 승차권을 들여다보는, 갈색 코트와 밝은 니트 차림.
deck.en: A brown coat over pale knitwear, on the shelter bench with a ticket to check while the rain comes down.
deck.de: Brauner Mantel über hellem Strick – auf der Bank im Wartehäuschen, das Ticket in der Hand, während es regnet.

copy.articleTitle: AT THE TRAM STOP IN THE RAIN

tip.ko: 비 오는 날 종이 승차권은 코트 안주머니에 넣어 두면 젖지 않아요.
tip.en: On a rainy day, a paper ticket stays dry in the inside pocket of your coat.
tip.de: An Regentagen bleibt ein Papierticket in der Innentasche des Mantels trocken.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery); English product names only sentence-cased (sourceNameEn)

howToWear.ko: 벤치에 앉기 전 긴 코트 자락을 양옆으로 정리한다.
howToWear.en: Move the long coat skirts aside before sitting.
howToWear.de: Die langen Mantelschöße vor dem Hinsetzen zur Seite legen.

howToWear.ko: 코트와 목도리 사이로 케이블 짜임을 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Let the cable pattern show between the coat and scarf.
howToWear.de: Das Zopfmuster zwischen Mantel und Schal sichtbar lassen.

howToWear.ko: 앉을 때 무릎이 편하도록 여유 있는 핏을 고른다.
howToWear.en: Choose a cut that leaves room at the knee when seated.
howToWear.de: Einen Schnitt mit Platz am Knie für das Sitzen wählen.

howToWear.ko: 두꺼운 양말 위에 끈을 고르게 조인다.
howToWear.en: Tighten the laces evenly over thick socks.
howToWear.de: Die Schnürsenkel über dicken Socken gleichmäßig festziehen.

name.en: Deep olive short ribbed fisherman beanie

products.sourceNameEn: deep olive short ribbed fisherman beanie

howToWear.ko: 갈색 코트에 짙은 올리브로 작은 색 차이를 준다.
howToWear.en: Pair the brown coat with a deep olive beanie for a subtle contrast.
howToWear.de: Den braunen Mantel mit einer dunkelolivgrünen Mütze kombinieren.

howToWear.ko: 밝은 프린지가 코트 앞에 보이도록 끝을 하나 내린다.
howToWear.en: Let one fringed end fall against the front of the coat.
howToWear.de: Ein Fransenende vorne am Mantel herunterhängen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 앉았을 때 부츠 위로 크림색 양말이 조금 보이게 신는다.
howToWear.en: Show a little cream wool above the boots when seated.
howToWear.de: Beim Sitzen etwas cremefarbene Wolle über den Stiefeln zeigen.
